freeze_note: See docs/reproducibility/evaluation-authoring.md; author intent was written before corpus inspection and labels were then adjudicated against the pinned fixture.
split_policy: six distinct scenario families per split; five independently phrased tasks per family; no family crosses the split

tasks.question: copy file location
tasks.rationale: The pinned cp example copies one source path to one destination path.

tasks.question: cp copy
tasks.rationale: The task names the selected command and requests its demonstrated file-copy behavior.

tasks.question: source destination
tasks.rationale: The example has source and destination placeholders and performs this operation.

tasks.question: copy files directories
tasks.rationale: The cp page description explicitly covers files and directories; its only indexed example is accepted.

tasks.question: move files to docs
tasks.rationale: Audit prompt retained as development-only; the pinned corpus has copy but no move example.

tasks.question: search patterns files
tasks.rationale: The Linux grep example searches for patterns in files.

tasks.question: grep -R recursively
tasks.rationale: The exact recursive flag and behavior match the indexed grep example.

tasks.question: pattern path
tasks.rationale: The example searches recursively for a pattern in a path.

tasks.question: find text in compressed logs
tasks.rationale: Audit prompt retained as development-only; no decompression-aware or zgrep example is in the pinned corpus.

tasks.question: grep search files
tasks.rationale: The recursive grep example is the only indexed example satisfying this task.

tasks.question: copy text clipboard
tasks.rationale: The osx pbcopy example copies file input to the clipboard.

tasks.question: pbcopy file
tasks.rationale: The example uses input redirection into pbcopy.

tasks.question: macOS clipboard
tasks.rationale: The platform-specific example demonstrates exactly this clipboard transfer.

tasks.question: standard input clipboard
tasks.rationale: The exact input behavior matches the indexed example.

tasks.question: copy
tasks.rationale: Intentionally ambiguous task; both selected copy examples are acceptable interpretations, exercising multiple-valid labels.

tasks.question: restart systemd
tasks.rationale: Audit prompt retained as development-only; systemd is absent from the pinned selection.
